query:
INSERT INTO organization_memberships (
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            role,
            status,
            deactivated_at
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3::user_role,
            $4::membership_status,
            CASE WHEN $4 = 'INACTIVE' THEN now() ELSE NULL END
         )
         RETURNING id
